|errata_history=This is the original printed text (version 1 of 4). The image is the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-00-Rise_Of_The_Dark_Lord.png]]), which prints this text. Versions in date order: '''this page''' (original, release sheet of 18 June 2010); [[Rise Of The Dark Lord (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Rise Of The Dark Lord (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); [[Rise Of The Dark Lord (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet (official text as of 18 June 2010): “Deploy on table (only at start of game) with three different [Vader] Effects from Reserve Deck face down under here. Once per turn, may deploy a [Vader] Effect from here (never from elsewhere). Limit one [Vader] Effect on table and, when lost, stack it under here. You may cancel your [Vader] Effect at any time. Twisted And Evil: Dark Jedi Presence, Jedi Presence, Revenge Of The Sith and Sith Tests are canceled. When using The Empire's Back to ▼ Vader, it is a Used Interrupt. If you just drew a [Vader] card for destiny, may take it into hand.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf#page=4 Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 18 June 2010"; copy re-made 28 July 2010), page 4, slip 19 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf#page=4 Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Dark Side, p. 35). Under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 ([[Rise Of The Dark Lord (Errata 3)]]), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=35, page 35. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=35 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Rise Of The Dark Lord (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads “(deploys only at start of game)” for “(only at start of game)” and “from your Reserve Deck” for “from Reserve Deck” (it writes ▼ out as “deploy … from Reserve Deck”, which is notation only): “Deploy on table (deploys only at start of game) with three different [Vader] Effects from your Reserve Deck face down under here. Once per turn, may deploy a [Vader] Effect from here (never from elsewhere). Limit one [Vader] Effect on table and, when lost, stack it under here. You may cancel your [Vader] Effect at any time.Twisted And Evil: Dark Jedi Presence, Jedi Presence, Revenge Of The Sith and Sith Tests are canceled. When using The Empire's Back to deploy Vader from Reserve Deck, it is a Used Interrupt. If you just drew a [Vader] card for destiny, may take it into hand.”<ref name="cl-1271_19-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text</ref> The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Rise Of The Dark Lord (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-riseofthedarklord-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text (this page) again, word for word: “Deploy on table (only at start of game) with three different [Vader] Effects from Reserve Deck face down under here. Once per turn, may deploy a [Vader] Effect from here (never from elsewhere). Limit one [Vader] Effect on table and, when lost, stack it under here. You may cancel your [Vader] Effect at any time. Twisted And Evil: Dark Jedi Presence, Jedi Presence, Revenge Of The Sith and Sith Tests are canceled. When using The Empire's Back to ▼ Vader, it is a Used Interrupt. If you just drew a [Vader] card for destiny, may take it into hand.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual7-Dark card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual7-Dark">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034727/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints the slip number “19” at the bottom right, which the release-sheet slip does not.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Rise Of The Dark Lord (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 35)<ref name="ml-ds" /> prints the original release-sheet text (this page) again, word for word: “Deploy on table (only at start of game) with three different [Vader] Effects from Reserve Deck face down under here. Once per turn, may deploy a [Vader] Effect from here (never from elsewhere). Limit one [Vader] Effect on table and, when lost, stack it under here. You may cancel your [Vader] Effect at any time. Twisted And Evil: Dark Jedi Presence, Jedi Presence, Revenge Of The Sith and Sith Tests are canceled. When using The Empire's Back to ▼ Vader, it is a Used Interrupt. If you just drew a [Vader] card for destiny, may take it into hand.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1271-19-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image do).
